name: Dark Paths, Leading Nowhere
source:
You are a reporter, here to investigate a crime of suspected supernatural origin. You talk with different witnesses, trying to pierce the truth together. Which of these narrators can you trust?

[From [url=https://tinyluciifer.itch.io/dark-paths]itch.io[/url]]
